notes.title: BattleCourt 1.2.0 Update
notes.content:
The BattleCourt 1.2.0 Update sees a complete overhaul of the screen position. The player now remains centred and a camera class now updates its position instead of the whole world. This was introduced as the collision system needed an overhaul. With smoother wall gliding and a slight bounce off, it feels better to collide! 

The new Camera System saw beyond the map edges, so all levels received spacial tears along their edges to look out into Space.

Visuals were improved with a complete redesign of the bosses and the Robot enemy, as well as introduction of a boss health bar when fighting a boss, player fire effects, and portal effects when an enemy spawns in. The bonus enemy also saw a change into a golden runner.

3 new levels were also added: Desert, Space Station, and Old School. Desert is a large open area with dust storms clouding your vision, Space Station a smaller area with ship hazards flying by, and Old School is a simple open area in the style of the 80s.

The goal of this update was to make improvements to visuals and gameplay, where I felt they were lacking. That being the Collision system, and the bosses. 

Full 1.2.0 Patchnotes:

            - Added a Camera class to now handle screen movement.
            - Player now stays centered to the screen and Position changes now move
                the Camera instead.
            - Overhauled the Player to Collidable Collision detection to be more
                smooth. Some cases of hitting the corners might stop movement.
            - Added edge tear to map edges.
            - Added a Star Field behind the map.
            - Added some more collidables to the Intersection level as spatial tears.
            - Fixed a bug with the stop signs on Intersection level not having
                collision.
            - Fixed a bug with the hazard on Snow Factory level getting stuck.
            - Waved Begins/Ends text now showing at the appropriate time.
            - Waved Begins/Ends text now showing on the tutorial level.
            - Added number formatting on enemy and player Health display numbers.
            - Added Boss HP Bar when a Boss appears. Disappears when Boss is killed. If
                playing on bosses only Enemy Challenge mode, the bar will not appear.
            - Added Coins earned from scrap stat to the death screen.
            - When dying now all guns in inventory are automatically scrapped. This
                only occurs on death and not if quitting to main menu, or winning
                the game. The scrap amount earnt is added to the total that is 
                shown on the death screen.
            - A portal visual effect has been added when enemies spawn in.
            - Main menu scroll rate now scrolls at the same rate regardless of FPS.
            - Fixed a bug causing the dash effect to play on starting a 2nd level.
            - Switched SamplerState from LinearWrap to PointClamp to prevent pixel
                draw position issues on anything other than 3840x2160 resolution.
            - Fixed a bug with multi beam collisions not working when aiming at the 
                -3 Pi / 2 radian sector and the extra beams passing over the 0 Pi
                radian line, and same in reverse.
            - Added more names to the Gun Name Generator.
            - Hazards are now drawn on the Main Menu Screen.
            - Added Portal effects to the Hazards on Railway and Snow Factory Levels.
            - Added Desert Level. A large open level that has dust storms making it
                harder to see. Enemies can also spawn at any point on the level edge.
            - Added Space Station Level. A small level that has hazard ships flying by.
            - Added new Spaceship hazard. Deals 100 damage on collision.
            - Added Old School Level. A large grid with simple graphics.
            - Fixed a bug causing error sound not to play on start game click when
                level start cost is more than your current coins.
            - Added a visual on the gun when a bullet is fired.
            - Redesigned the look of the Zombie Boss.
            - Redesigned the look of the UFO Boss.
            - UFO Boss now can pass through collidables, and is drawn on top.
            - UFO Boss no longer spawns in aliens.
            - UFO Boss bullet move speed increased from 250 to 750.
            - Changed UFO Boss Pathfind logic, now aims at you until it gets close, 
                and then turn to avoid.
            - Added Turn rate functionality to the UFO Boss. Instead of snapping
                to the calculated Pathfind angle, it slowly turns toward it.
            - Fixed a bug with Explosive damage calculation on the player.
            - Redesigned the look of the Mech Boss.
            - Redesigned the look of the Robot Enemy.
            - Bonus enemy is now a Golden Runner instead of a Barrel.
            - Changed the background of the Tutorial Level.
            - Adjusted the Tutorial Level's world edges to 192px.
            - Added backdrop for the Main menu buttons.
            - Menu buttons no longer change color depending on the background.
            - Leg animation speed now stays consistent regardless of Framerate.
            - Added Toilet Paper gun. a Tier 1 rapid fire that deals additional
                poison damage.

notes.title: BattleCourt 1.1.0 Update - The Creation Update
notes.content:
The Creation Update:

BattleCourt 1.1.0 Introduces the ability to create your own weapons and modifiers at a cost of coins. Make some wacky or Over powered combos to handle the new Wave structuring featuring 3 new enemy difficulty types and an improvement to late game waves.

Also introduced in the Wave restructure is a bonus wave every 10th wave of flying barrels with a 100% chance to drop coins. Bosses now also appear every 30th wave instead of every 28th.

A rebalance of the daily mission starting weapon, some changes to the UFO and Mech bosses, and general rebalancing and bugfixes can be found in this update.

The goal of this update was to focus on Player Customization and Creation with the introduction of the 2 creation features plus over 20 new costumes to find throughout gameplay drops.

v1.1.0 Full Patchnotes:
            - Fixed a Minor Bug with Modifier display of Permanent guns doubling up 
                on new game.
            - Fixed a Minor Bug with gun header color not updating when hovering 
                over a permanent gun followed by an equipped gun and vice versa 
                in the Loadout menu.
            - Lowered the Lightning damage tick of the Tier 1 Light Beam from 100  
                down to 30.
            - Increased the Leech Unique mod leech amount to 0.1 HP. (up from 0.01)
            - Fixed CTD on first opening Loadout menu on a fresh save.
            - Fixed Floating point display issue on Loot Rarity and Max Movespeed
                upgrades on the Loadout Menu.
            - Added input field functionality.
            - Added Create Modifier Menu.
            - Added ability to create custom modifiers. The modifier rarity and creation
                cost is generated from the overall mod weight. Certain mod effects
                have a higher weight than others. E.G. incrementing Damage will
                increment mod weight by 1, where incrementing Leech will
                increment mod weight by 35.
            - Mod Cost calculation increments even when setting mod values to
                red. This is to prevent easy 0 cost Mods by simply setting
                one value heavily in the red.
            - Added Full modifier list display. Created modifiers will be added to
                the display at the end of the appropriate Rarity list.
            - Added Savefile for Created Mods.
            - Electric DoT and Slow Effect have now been split.
            - Electric DoT no longer applies a Slow Effect on both gun base stats
                and added modifiers.
            - Electric DoT now Defaults to 4 second duration.
            - Fixed bug causing MoveSpeed Slow and Speedup on enemies not to apply.
            - Enemy MoveSpeed modifiers now resolve in this order: 
                Slow > Fire > Poison. Meaning if a weapon applies all 3, the enemies
                final MoveSpeed will be based on Poison. (10% Slow)
            - Added new Great Modifier: Crippling. Applies 10 Second Slow, Weaken,
                and Vulnerability.
            - Re-added the approx. 60 shots/sec fire rate limit.
            - Shrunk the Spike Trap Bullet to fit better in gun info screens.
            - Now preventing gun damage from being less than 0.
            - Added Create Weapon Menu.
            - Added ability to create custom weapons. The weapon tier and cost
                is generated from the dps, bullet effects, and Damage Type
                that is applied to the weapon.
            - Added certain dependencies and preventions to the weapon
                creation. Example, if DamageType is set to Beam, Pierce will be set
                to true and not be toggleable. Another example, if Bullets shot
                count is set at 1, Spread will not be adjustable. Setting Bullets
                shot to 2 or greater, will enable the Spread toggle.
            - Changing Damage Type in weapon creation will change all values to
                default values suitable to that Damage Type.
            - Added Full weapon list display. Created Weapons will be added to
                the bottom of the display list, and added to the appropriate
                tier and damage type lists. This means that created weapons
                will generate in the Permanent buy, throughout Gameplay, and
                to the Daily Level lists.
            - Added Scrap Multiple functionality to the Loadout Screen. Button
                appears above the Permanent weapon display section.
            - Added functionality for beams and rails to have multiple fired at once.
            - Added Copper Dual Directed Energy Tier 2 Weapon.
            - Added Copper Tri Directed Energy Tier 2 Weapon.
            - Added Cupronickel Dual Mega Energy Tier 3 Weapon.
            - Added Cupronickel Tri Mega Energy Tier 3 Weapon.
            - Added Cupronickel Dual 50cal Tier 2 Weapon.
            - Added Cupronickel Tri 50cal Tier 2 Weapon.
            - Added Reinold Dual Lamma Tier 4 Weapon.
            - Added Reinold Tri Lamma Tier 4 Weapon.
            - Added Reinold Quad Lamma Tier 4 Weapon.
            - Added Reinold Quin Lamma Tier 4 Weapon.
            - Added Reinold Sext Lamma Tier 4 Weapon.
            - Changed the Music of the Boss Waves to be more fitting.
            - Changed the Music of the Main Menu.
            - Overhauled how the Waves spawn.
            - Rebalanced almost all Enemy Challenges.
            - Boss Waves now appear at Wave 30, 60, and 90 instead of Wave 28, 56,
                and 84.
            - Added Bonus Wave on each 10th wave that isn't a boss wave (eg. 10, 20).
            - Added new Bonus Enemy that spawns on Bonus Waves. It has a 100% 
                chance to drop a coin crate, flies through the map in a straight line 
                without colliding with objects. Destroy each one before it flies offscreen.
            - Fixed bug with completing Winterlands or Snow Factory did not unlock the
                Enemy and Gun Challenges.
            - Buffed the Mech Boss weapon. Fires once per 3 seconds (up from 4), deals
                10 base + explosive splash damage (up from 5), bullet move speed
                increased to 1500 (up from 900), and now fires 4 missles at once.
            - Changed the UFO Boss Weapon. Now fires 24 bullets at 3 shots/sec that
                move very slowly (More of a bullet hell type fire pattern).
            - Bosses are no longer immune to Electric Damage (as the damage is now split
                from the slow effect).
            - Fixed bug causing the Advanced and Expert Robots, UFO Boss, and Mech Boss
                to not have the correct shadow.
            - Added 3 new Enemy difficulty Types. Ultra, Super, and Hyper. The full
                enemy difficulty types are:
                Normal (Waves 1-30)
                Advanced (Waves 31-60)
                Expert (Waves 61-90)
                Ultra (Waves 91-120)
                Super (Waves 121-150)
                Hyper (Waves 151-180)
            - Added 3 new Bosses. AdvancedZombieBoss, AdvancedUFOBoss, 
                and AdvancedMechBoss.
                AdvancedZombieBoss spawns at wave 120
                AdvancedUFOBoss spawns at wave 150
                AdvancedMechBoss spawns at wave 180
            - Waves now continue up to Wave 181 max. (was 121 max)
            - Fixed bug allowing multiple Victory payouts when set to Boss Enemy
                Challenge.
            - Increased cost to set the Start wave by a factor of 2.5 to ensure
                cost to start on a Boss Wave is more than the payout.
            - Cost to Buy Tier 1 permanent gun increased to 250 coins.
            - Cost to Buy Tier 2 permanent gun increased to 2,500 coins.
            - Cost to Buy Tier 3 permanent gun increased to 25,000 coins.
            - Cost to Buy Tier 4 permanent gun increased to 250,000 coins.
                (Coins received from scrapping permanent guns will remain the same)
            - Daily can now start at any wave between 0 - 50 (was 0 - 40).
            - Changed the starting weapon of Insane difficulty to Reinold Mortar.
            - Changed the starting weapons of Daily missions to be one Tier higher.
            - Fixed bug with the Basketball rings not having a collision.
            - Added new Level, One Way Street. Enemies run downward instead of at 
                the player.
            - Added Lighting Overlay functionality. Only used in One Way Street at 
                this stage.
            - Enemies Killed by being far off level bounds no longer drop loot.
            - Added 3 new Skeleton Costumes unlockable through in game drops.
            - Added 12 new Silly Costumes unlockable through in game drops.
            - Added 9 new Old School Costumes unlockable through in game drops.

This was a priority minor update to fix a bug with coins being able to be doubled each time you die.

BattleCourt Minor Update 1.0.3 Patchnotes:

- Fixed a Bug with Coins being Updated on Load causing it to Double each time.
- Fixed a Bug with Player Health display being incorrect on starting a new game after already playing one.

notes.title: BattleCourt 1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
BattleCourt 1.0.2 Update focused on a lot of Behind the Scenes fixes with a complete code restructure on how strings, music,  and images are handled in the Update and Draw ticks.

Originally the game was generating a lot of garbage causing the GC to fire constantly to clean up the unused data. Now the GC will rarely fire resulting in cleaner CPU use.

To go with the theme of Garbage Collection, 2 new Guns have been added. Garbage Gun, a T1 Rapid Firing Trash, and a Garbage Can Gun, a T3 Garbage Can Gun firing a Piercing Garbage Can.

Full 1.0.2 Patchnotes:
- Changed Music Functionality to use a MusicManager Class.
- Fixed a Bug with Music creating multiple Content Instances, which was
	causing a memory leak and eventually causing music to stop.
- Fixed Bug with Music display info text not being in the correct position on
	Screen resolution change.
- Removed Grid for Collision events as it was creating too much garbage.
- Changed text when hovering over scrap item button to just say
	'Scrap Item'.
- Restructured Code to prevent almost all Garbage Collection on Main Menu.
- Removed all tutorial text.
- Restructured Code to prevent almost all Garbage Collection in Gameplay.
- Added Garbage Gun T1. Rapid firing trash.
- Added Garbage Can Gun T3. Fire a Piercing Garbage Can.

notes.title: BattleCourt 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
BattleCourt 1.0.1 Small Hotfix has been released with only 1 in game change and 1 Content Pipeline change. 

- Fixed bug with Clicking Use gamepad if available button making it move.
- Content Pipeline now includes TTF file of any custom fonts to prevent possible font issues.

notes.title: BattleCourt - Out of Early Access
notes.content:
This minor update has pushed BattleCourt from Beta 1.5.3 into Full Release v1.0.0

The decision was made to move to full release as the main remaining bugs were fixed with the Beta 1.5.3 update, and this current update addressed some minor issues.

The next Major update will focus on adding more content through Levels, Guns, Costumes, and Modifiers as well as add in game mod support.

Thank you all.

v1.0.0 Full Patchnotes:

- Moved to Full Release.
- Added Achievements for Completing Winterlands and Snowfactory on each 
    difficulty.
- Added Biomancer kills stats to Game Over Screen.
- Aligned Game Over Scren Stats text more to the left.
- Lowered Advanced Biomancer bullet hit damage from 25 to 15.
- Lowered Expert Biomancer bullet hit damage from 50 to 30.
- Added Keybind Info for Speed Up/Slow Down on Controller.
- Added new Collidable type - Hole. Bullets can pass through Holes, but
    enemies and players can't.
- Converted the Holes to use the Hole Object Type in appropriate levels.
- Menu Text appears Blue if Background is Winterlands or Snow Factory.
- Added UI Back for Music Info.
- Fixed Dash Effect to remain more in line with player on all conditions.

notes.title: BattleCourt Beta 1.5.3 Update
notes.content:
The Beta 1.5.3 Update has added a few Quality of Life features like the scrap from, for easy scrapping of mass items in players inventory. Powerup functionality has been added with 4 powerups to find. Some visual updates, and a bunch of bug fixes with 2 long term bugs finally fixed.

Please note: it is possible Controller functionality has broken with this update, Which I am unsure why it has done so as nothing has changed at all in terms of the controller code.
If it has happened to be broken, it will be priority fix for next update.

These features are in preperation for the full release most likely next major update. Which will focus on adding Semi Mod support.

Thank You All.

BattleCourt Beta 1.5.3 full Patchnotes:

- Reverted Alien Pathfinding back to always aim at player.
- Aliens now move at 30% speed when they are further than 1600 units
    away.
- Dropped Spawn rates of Biomancer and moved their first appearance to
    Wave 12 on Default (Up from Wave 6).
- Dropped Biomancer firing rate to 1 Shot every 2.5sec(down from 1.25sec).
- Reduced Zombie Boss HP to 300,000 (Was 1,000,000).
- Reduced UFO Boss HP to 1,250,000 (Was 2,500,000).
- Reduced Mech Boss HP to 5,000,000 (Was 10,000,000).
- Biomancers no longer shoot while frozen.
- Loadout no longer saves on each permanent gun buy/sell. Now saves on 
    exit and game start instead. 
- Fixed Bug with Nuke Courtyard not working.
- Changed visual effect when Nuking Courtyard.
- Fixed Bug where all enemies and collidables weren't being destroyed
    when nuking the courtyard.
- Added song display info. Defaults to off.
- Added song display toggle option in options menu.
- 1360x768 Aspect Ratio now sets correctly(1360x768). Originally was
    setting (1360x764) incorrectly.
- Fixed bug with line edges on half-pixel draws on lower resolutions.
- Changed how scale matrix works. No longer scales on just ScreenWidth,
    instead scales on both ScreenWidth and ScreenHeight.
- Removed HUD reposition Code as no longer needed.
- Added 'Scrap Multiple' functionality to inventory. Clicking the
    'Scrap Multiple' Button under the inventory will allow you to Remove
    all Weapons in your inventory at the specified Rarity and lower.
    You will gain Scrap from all Weapons that were Scrapped and will
    contribute to appropriate Scrap Challenges.
- Reverted Beams back to using Raycast Collision instead of Bullet Collision.
- Beams can no longer damage offscreen enemies (But can pierce walls).
- Beam and Rail Bullet visuals are no longer destroyed when hitting a wall.
- Added Nitrogen Gasser - Tier 2. Freezes anything hit by the gas.
- Added Hydrogen Gasser - Tier 2. Explodes when gas hits an enemy.
- Added Griffel Gatling Launcher - Tier 2. Rapid fire small missiles.
- Added Griffel HG Launcher - Tier 3. Rapid fire missiles.
- Added Griffel UG Launcher - Tier 4. Rapid fire big missiles.
- Added Griffel UF Grenadier - Tier 3. Rapid fire grenades around you.
- Added Cobalt Plasma Omegawave - Tier 4. Fires Piercing waves around 
    you.
- Added Positional Audio and Random Pitch to all bullet explosions.
- Increased overall Positional Audio volumes.
- Fixed bug with flak Grenades all firing in one direction at the same time,
    now Grenades will spread as they should.
- Rebalanced Daily Challenge rewards to be more rewarding on harder 
    difficulty, later waves, and higher wave count dailies.
- Boss Enemy Challenge reward modifier changed to 50x. (From 20x).
- Biomancer Enemy Challenge reward modifier changed to 3.6x. (From 1.5x).
- Base Victory coin reward increased to 2,500. (Was 1,000). Meaning 
    winning is now more rewarding.
- Converted Player Coins from int to double.
- Converted Upgrade Costs from float to double.
- Converted Scrap Amount from int to double.
- Added Rotation Effect to all Loot Crates.
- Added Powerups Functionality to game.
- Added Powerup: Invulnerable. You are Invulnerable for 20 Seconds on
    pickup.
- Added Powerup: Invulnerable + Melee. You are Invulnerable for 20 
    Seconds on pickup and you deal 100 damage to any enemy you collide 
    with. Uses hazard immunity timers on enemies. You become the Hazard.
- Added Powerup: Speed. You have 2x Move Speed for 20 Seconds on pickup.
- Added Powerup: Magnet. You pull all Loot Crates toward you for 20 
    Seconds on pickup. Does not pull Powerups toward you.
- Added Powerup timer info to the right of weapon info in HUD when a 
    powerup is active.
- Transition Song now is random between Logo 1 - 10, instead of only Logo 6.
- Dropped Transition time to 18sec. (was 20sec).
- Fixed bug which caused edges to overscroll.
- Changed enemy Wave spawn points on the Island map. Enemies will now 
    appear from all directions instead of just left and right.
- Added new Collidable type - Ice. Movement is more slippery on ice.
- Added new Level - Winterlands. A snowy area with an Icy lake in the 
    center.
- Added new Level - Snow Factory. A factory in the middle of the snow.

notes.title: BattleCourt Beta 1.5.2 Update
notes.content:
BattleCourt Beta 1.5.2 Full Patchnotes:

- Allowed Blood splatter effect to occur while enemy is in water.
	Blood stains will still not draw while in water.
- Changed Enemy immunity timers. Enemy immunity will apply a static
	0.05 sec immunity if the bullet is a non-beam piercing bullet.
	Explosive damage has a 0.1sec immunity to prevent splash overdamage,
	and beams now set the enemy immunity timer based on the firing rate
	of the gun.
- Fixed a bug that didn't draw blood splatter effect when Robots are hit
	by a Raycast collision.
- FPS Display now rounds to nearest whole number, and updates once a
	second instead of every frame.
- Added a heap of Prefixes and Suffixes to the Gun Name Generator.

    challenges.
- Added positional audio to Robot death explosion sound.
- Added 16 new Achievements. 4 for each new Level.

    Achievements, which is the max at this stage. The 4 Dungeon

notes.title: BattleCourt Beta 1.5 Update
notes.content:
BattleCourt Beta 1.5 Adds new Functionality to the Game.

[h1]FEATURES ADDED[/h1]

- Boss Overhaul. Zombie Boss and UFO Boss now spawn enemies. UFO Boss also Fires 8 lasers every 2 Seconds in random Directions, and Mech boss Fires a Homing Missile every 4 Seconds.
- Water Overhaul. When enterring water a splash effect and sound plays. While in water a water wave animation surrounds the player. Enemies also gain the effects.
- Positional Audio. Audio Events such as enemies dying, the new Hazards, and Enemy Water Splash sounds now have positional and random pitch added. The Sound Event volume becomes softer if further away. If it occurs left or right it plays on your speakers to best represent that position. Random Pitch also adds variance to the sounds such as the Water Splash and Enemy Death sound.
- A New Enemy Type - Biomancer, which fires projectiles at the player. Achievements assigned and Biomancer only Enemy Level Modifier added as well as added Biomancers to the Default Waves.
- Enemy Projectiles. Used in the Biomancer and now the UFO and Mech Bosses. Allowing for more enemy types to be added which fire projectiles.
- 4 new Levels. Island, Warehouse, Railway, and Dungeon.
- Hazards. Hazards can damage both the player and enemies. Current Hazards include the Minecarts on the railway level, and the Ghost Skulls on the dungeon level. Use the hazards to help you destroy enemies while avoiding damage to yourself.
- 2 new Weapons, Spike Trap (Tier 1) and Cannon (Tier 4).

[h1]WHAT'S NEXT[/h1]
For anyone who follows me on youtube, you might have seen I am building a 3d Engine to have my next release be a fully fleshed out 3D ARPG which is taking up most of my time now. I plan to keep adding features and eventually get BattleCourt to Full release in the next few updates.

I am also going to spend some time working on making a better trailer for the game.

Thank you all,
Luke Parisi


[h1]FULL BETA 1.5 PATCHNOTES[/h1]

- Added Grid System to be used for Collision.
- Changed Collision to check for Player->Collidable Collision in Grid 
	Co-Ord Occupied by player, and 8 Surrounding Cells. Instead of every
	single Collidable.
- Allowed Wall Slide so walls feel less sticky.
- Aliens now slowly roam around if they are Greater than 800 Units away.
- Removed Barrels from Level Start spawn.
- Fixed Bug that Didn't save Coins after buying Upgrades.
- Weakened the Knockback Effect of the Wind Modifier to 1/6th of the Value.
- New Enemy Type Added: Biomancer. Moves slowly and fires Projectiles at
	player. 4 new Achievements and 1 Challenge added for Biomancers.
- Added Enemy Challenge Mode - Biomancers Only, with 1 new Achievement.
- Added Biomancers to the Default and x2 Enemy Challenge Modes.          
- Loot Tables added to the Biomancer with the same Drop Rates as Ghosts,
	at 4% Base Drop Rate.
- Zombie Bosses now spawn 3 Basic Zombies every 5 Seconds.
- All Bosses HP Increased By x10.
- Added Sound Position, Volume, and Random Pitch functionality used in
	enemies gun Fire.
- Mech Bosses now Fires a Homing Missle Every 4 Seconds.
- UFO Bosses now Fires 8 Lasers Every 2 Seconds in random Directions
	around it.
- UFO Bosses now spawn 3 Basic Aliens every 5 Seconds.
- Bosses are now Immune to Electric Damage Due to the slow effect.
- Fixed bug where boss Confuse, Stun, Weaken, and Vulnerable immunity was
	not working. Bosses are now immune to those status effects correctly.
- Added Sound splash when entering water for player and enemies. Enemies
	splash sound uses Sound Functionality added in this patch. Player
	splash sound uses random Pitch.
- Player and Enemy Shadows and Feet are no longer drawn while in water.
- Added Splash Visual Effect when entering water.
- Enemy Splatter and Death stains no longer draw on water.
- Added Water Visual Effect while in water.
- Cleared the Beach and Courtyard Water.
- The Beach Level Water is now swimmable.
- New T2,T3 and T4 Beams have their Base Damage Reduced by 50%.
- Added new Level - Island. No Achievements assigned at this stage.
- Added new Level - Warehouse. No Achievements assigned at this stage.
- Added new Level - Railway. No Achievements assigned at this stage.
- Added new Level - Dungeon. No Achievements assigned at this stage.
- Added Hazards. Hazards hurt the Player and Enemies on Collision.
	NOTE: Hazards Damage to Player can be reduced with Damage Reduction.
- Added Minecart Hazards to Railway Level. Minecarts will roll on the
	tracks from left and right at random speeds.          
- Added Positional + Random Pitch Audio to Wall Destruction.
- Added Sound Effect and Positional + Random Pitch Audio to Enemy Deaths.
- Added Skull Hazards to Dungeon Level. Skulls will move in random
	directions around the map.
- Added Positional Audio to Minecarts and Skulls.
- Beams no longer use Raycasting Collision, now works the same as other
	rapid fire guns. This is to prevent beams damaging through walls.
	Rails/Snipers still use Raycasting, so they will pierce walls.
- New tier 4 gun added - Cannon. Fires piercing Big-Explosion bullets.
- New tier 1 gun added - Spike Trap. Damages anything that passes through.
- Explosive bullets that pierce no longer cast an explosion on Collision
	with Enemies. They will still explode when hitting a wall.
- Enemies now Have ImmunityTimers. 0.05 seconds for Beams and 0.1 seconds
	for every other gun. Explosion Immunity is seperate to other damage 
	types.
- Added Level Descriptions in the Level Select Menu.

notes.title: Beta 1.4.3 Update
notes.content:
Beta 1.4.3 Update Patchnotes:

- Changed Daily to require a minimum of 5 waves.
- Added 1920x800 and 3840x1600 resolution options.
- Moved Menus upward so they aren't cut off on 21:9 aspect ratios.
- Trimmed the Achievement, Inventory and Patchnotes Menu Heights to fit on 21:9 aspect ratio screens.
- Fixed bug with HUD UI elements not being in correct position on start up on some resolutions.
- Changed player movement functionality. Player now remains close to centre of the screen unless reaching map edges.
- Zombie Outfit styles on Basketball Court are now the same as the other Levels.
- Added Frenzy Animated Costume. Unlockable by Upgrading Scrap Amount to 10.
- Added Wave Fast Forward Functionality and Button appearing to the right of the Wave Display. Click to toggle between x3 speed or normal speed. If using controller, toggle with Right Shoulder (RB).
- Added 10 Wireframe Loot Drop Costumes.
- Changed Selected Costume Button highlight to Green in the Loadout Menu.
- Weapon Info stays displayed while the Equip Weapon menu is active.
- Equip Slot menu now has a fixed position instead of appearing next to the Equip button of the selected gun. Changed so that it doesn't cover the display of the Weapon Info.
- Added Weapon Display info of equipped weapon when hovering over it in the equip menu for easier comparisons.
- Added Ability to swap equipped weapon positions. Buttons to switch appear above the equip slots while in Inventory. Only swapping is available, unequipping is not available as that can be abused to get coins very easily and will cause an issue if no guns are equipped.
- Wall Weapon type Placeable Wall Textures redone to suit the game style a bit better.
- Large Wall Placer firing rate improved from 0.22 to 0.66 shots/sec.
- Samll Wall Placer firing rate improved from 0.33 to 1 shot/sec.
- Leech Modifier added. Only obtainable as a unique mod at this stage.


[u][b]More Info[/b][/u]
The features added in this update were a few things I had been meaning to add and mainly requests from the community. 

Support for 21:9 aspect ratios has been added with the option to select 1920x800 or 3840 x 1600 resolutions as well as a bug fix around the load up resolution display (the HUD elements were not positioning correctly). 

You can now switch what weapon slot the equipped weapon is in by clicking the number buttons above the equip weapon HUD display while the inventory screen is active.
Unequip was considered but it can be easily abused by purchasing a permanent gun, starting a game unequipping and selling then starting a new game. 
The weapon stat info screen stays displayed now if you click to equip the weapon. Also if you hover over one of the equip slots that currently has a gun equipped, a comparison window comes up for easy weapon comparison.
Due to these changes the equip slot sub menu no longer appears next to the equip weapon button that was clicked, it now has a permanent position under the weapon stat display.

The Wave Fast Forward button appears at the top of the screen next to the Current Wave Display. It can be clicked to toggle between 1x and 3x spawn speeds. This only speeds up how quickly the enemies spawn in as well as the intermission and wave timers, it doesn't speed up the overall game speed.

The player positioning now remains more centred unless you reach the map edge. How I set up the game was for free player movement unless it hits an edge of one of 4 invisible movement walls that remain centred on the screen. If the player hits one of the edges, instead of adjusting player position, it adjusts all other object positions (Screen Scrolling). Before this update i set the walls at a fixed distance from screen edge of 764 pixels, Now I have set it to 0.45 of screenHeight /0.45 of screenWidth. 
This means the player gas a smaller area of free movement before hitting one of the edges to start scrolling screen.
If the player is near a map edge, this logic is ignored and instead the player keeps moving. This setup allows for a more centred player position and prevents screen overscrolling on map edges.

More costumes have been added with 10 wireframe costumes as loot drops to find, and Frenzy costume linked to the scrapping achievement. This costume is the first animated costume that has been added to the game. This costume was made as a reference to the player Frenzy.

Leech Modifier has also been added and due to it being an extremely strong modifier to get, I have limited it to a unique mod roll, and only leeches 1% of hit damage at this stage.

Walls also received a change with new Images that are more basic but suit the game better, and adjustments to the firing rates as walls were pretty useless. This change makes them a more usable. 

Thank you all for the feedback and suggestions which were a part of this update. 

Regards,
Luke Parisi

notes.title: BattleCourt Beta 1.4 Update
notes.content:
[h1]BattleCourt Beta 1.4 Update[/h1]

[h2]Progression[/h2]

Progression has been added to BattleCourt in a few ways. You can now earn coins through beating Levels, Doing Daily Level Challenges, and Scrapping unwanted weapons.
With these coins you can now spend them in the new Loadout Section (formerly Costumes).
Here you can purchase Upgrades for your character, Permanent Guns to customise your startout, and Unlock Gun Slots to equip the Permanent Guns in.

Challenges have also been added, and increase throughout your entire playtime. Challenges such as Deal Base Damage, Collect Loot, Take Damage, and plenty more. These Challenges Gain Levels as you progress through them, and each level increases certain stats such as the Deal Base Damage increases your Base Damage by 2.5% for each level completed in the Challenge, or the Collect Loot which increases your Loot Drop Chance by 1% for each level. 

Level Difficulty now exists which the harder difficulties require you to upgrade your character to even stand a chance of completing.

Included with all the Progression Update is a Big addition to Achievements to earn, upping the game total achievements to over 80. 

[h2]Level Selection Overhaul[/h2]

As mentioned, this update added an overhaul to the Level Selection. Now with a new menu with a larger visual of the Level. Within this menu you can select the Level Difficulty, and Once Unlocked you can select Level Gun Modifiers, and Level Enemy Modifiers. These Modifiers can be things like Cobalt Guns Only, Rail Guns Only, only Boss Enemies, Mass Zombies, Enemy Spawn x2, and a few more.

Each Difficulty and Level Modifier will adjust the Coin Multiplier. This means that if you earn victory on that level the coins you earned will be multiplied by that Coin Multiplier. Base Coins Earned for victory is 1000.

[h2]Coins[/h2]

Coins are now a big part of the progression and can be earned as mentioned above through winning levels, doing Daily Level Challenges, or Scrapping Guns. The balance has been set to something I feel would be balanced, but it is highly likely that these values will be adjusted.

[h2]Gameplay UI[/h2]

Gameplay UI has been slightly changed, with the HUD showing 2 new buttons to the left of the equipped guns. One of these is the Inventory Button, and the other is Challenges Button. 
Challenges also recieved a key binding with default to C and can be rebound in the options-> keybinding section. Also note that the game will now prevent you from binding the same key to multiple functions, if the key has already been bound to something and you try to bind it, it will play an error sound. This is just temporary functionality until I setup a keybind switch for binding an already bound key.
The Loadout Permanent weapon Scrollable Nob and the Inventory Scrollable Nob now start at the bottom of the bar. This is so that any new weapons collected will be visible straight away on the bottom of the list, with older weapons moving above the bottom. Eventually I will switch it back to the top and have the list add new rows underneath the latest.

[h2]What's next[/h2]
The next update will focus on any bugfixes, adding new content, and a boss overhaul.

[h2]Full Patchnotes[/h2]

- Changed the Level Selection Menu Functionality.
- Added Level Difficulty.
- Added Modifiers to enemy Health, Speed, and Attack Damage based on difficulty.
- Advanced Zombie Base Drop Chance now 7% (Down from 8%
- Expert Zombie Base Drop Chance now 7% (Down from 9%)");
- Advanced Alien Base Drop Chance now 6% (Down from 7%
- Expert Alien Base Drop Chance now 6% (Down from 8%
- Advanced Runner Base Drop Chance now 5% (Down from 6%
- Expert Runner Base Drop Chance now 5% (Down from 7%
- Advanced Ghost Base Drop Chance now 4% (Down from 5%
- Expert Ghost Base Drop Chance now 4% (Down from 6%
- Advanced Robot Base Drop Chance now 8% (Down from 9%
- Expert Robot Base Drop Chance now 8% (Down from 10%
- Barrel Base Drop Chance now 5% (Down from 10%
- Drop Chance Distribution Changed to 2% Costume, 8% HP, 90% Weapon and no HP Crates drop on Insane. Originally was  (5% Costume, 25% HP, 70% Weapon).
- Adjusted Loot Drop Chance of Difficulties as follows:
    Easy: Default Drop Chances (No Change to Base Chance
    Medium: -1% Drop Chances
    Hard: -2% Drop Chances
    Very Hard: -3% Drop Chances
    Insane: -4% Drop Chances.
- Added Gun Level Modifier Settings.
- Added Enemy Level Modifier Settings.
- Added Coin Multiplier.
- Added Gun Lists for specific Gun Setting Modes used in Loot Rolls.
- Reworked Wave System to changed based off what Enemy Setting is set.
- Added Achievements for Levels beaten on Easy,Medium,Hard, and Very Hard.
- Added Achievement for any Level beaten on Insane.
- Added Victory Menu.
- Changed Costumes Menu to Loadout Menu.
- Moved Player Code from LoadManager to ScreenManager so that it can
    be used in the main menu for things like weapons to be set.
- Added LoadoutState Save File which stores your Equipped and Permanent
    weapon data.
- Added Coin Image and Functionality.
- Added Weapon Functionality to Loadout.
- Added Permanent Weapons. These weapons stay in your game unless you
    delete them. These can be switched with your equip menu to customize
    your starting loadout for every game.
- Added Buy Tier 1-4 Weapons Rolls randomly.
- Equip Weapon functionality to Loadout. Permanent Weapons can be set
    to your starting equipped gun Loadout for every match.
- Added Locked Slots Functionality. Slots 2-4 are Locked initially for
    the Loadout. These slots can still be used in game.
- Fixed Bug with Common Rarity not dropping.
- Added Upgrade to HP. 100 Coin, Increment 1.5x, +5 HP Per Level.
- Added Upgrade to Start Crates. 500 Coin, Increment 1.5x, +1 Per Level.

    Bonus Damage applies after all other damage is calculated.

    Level. Damage Reduction Applies after any other Damage Reduction,
    such as from Weakened Enemies.

   NOTE: Damages above 1 still round to the whole number.

notes.title: Beta 1.3.3 Update
notes.content:
The Beta 1.3.3 Update focused on fixing a lot of bugs, and adding some more content. There are now 2 new Enemy States, 25 new costumes, 2 new Wall type weapons, and 1 new Trap type weapon.
I have prioritised the bug fixes for this Update with Many bugs being found by the community. 
I would like to say a big thank you to Frenzy for finding and bringing to my attention a big chunk of bugs, as well as Janneman for the bug with enemies spawn.

A few bugs were to do with Collision so I have spent a bit of time overhauling the Collision detection. There are now a few methods in place that should prevent anyone from getting stuck in walls as well as the enemies getting stuck.

There was also a big change to the Settings.INI file formatting to make it more readable and scalable so that in future I can add changes to it without the game having to reset it. This change will unfortunately reset any keybinds that were set. 

[b]
Beta Update 1.3.3 Patchnotes:
[/b]
- Reintroduced acceleration to movement in a way that doesn't spike on FPS drops.
- Fixed Homing turn rate on High FPS. Now uses DeltaTime in calculation.
- Enemy -> Enemy Collisions now use DeltaTime in repulsion calculation.
- Enemy -> Collidable Collisions changed to be similar to Player -> Collidable collision.
- Fixed Bug that allowed player to use Health Crate when dead.
- Enemy Spawn now uses AimPoint as a target on initial spawn. Originally the enemies were aiming forward for 2 seconds after spawning.
- Fixed Bug that had enemies get stuck in the spawn point wall.
- Added HP Text Display Functionality and toggleable in options menu.
- Changed how Options.INI is read to make it more readable and scalable. This will reset any saved keybindings, however it should be the last time they will reset.
- Fixed bug where you could get stuck between walls.
- Completely Changed how Player Collision works.
- Changed Button text to display On/Off instead of True/False.
- Removed Invisible Wall on the Water of the Courtyard Level.
- Fixed Bug where screen would scroll on Death.
- Moved the barrels slightly on the courtyard level.
- Gun Accuracy is now shown in the HUD stat as well as Inventory.
- Gun Spread Changed to show the Spread for weapons with multiple bullets fired in one shot. The Gun Spread is the range those bullets will  spread out. Even if the gun has 100% Accuracy they still will spread out a bit for flak weapons.");
- Enemy knockback now applies to Player Velocity instead of a flat position change.
- Added Enemy Weakened State. Enemies that are Weakened will hit for half of their usual damage during this State.
- Added Weakened modifier to Weapons.
- Added Enemy Vulnerable State. Enemies that are vulnarable will take 25% more damage during this State.
- Added Vulnerable modifier to Weapons.
- Added 3 Costumes unlockable with the 100,000 Robots Achievement.
- Added 1 Costume unlockable with the Pay your Respects Achievement.
- Added 21 Costumes unlockable as Loot Drops.
- Added new Wall Gun Type and 2 Wall Guns: Tier 1 Small Concrete and Tier 3 Large Concrete. Walls Use the Bullet Damage as the Wall Health. This means Modifiers to bullet Damage will increase the Wall Health.
- Added Gravity Trap. Works Similar to wall, but pulls objects into it.

[b]What's next[/b]
I will be focusing on overhauling Level Selection and adding Difficulty and Challenge modes. I have had a few suggestions for Challenge mode / Missions and content to add more replayability and to give a feel of progression. 
With these suggestions I have been spending a lot of time thinking about how to go about it. This will be the priority of the next update along with fixing any major bugs that might have come up. 

I really appreciate all the suggestions and feedback you guys have been giving me and I will continue to listen to this so that I can make the game better and better for you guys.

Thank you all
Luke Parisi

notes.title: Beta 1.3.2 Update
notes.content:
BattleCourt Beta 1.3.2 Patchnotes:

- Changed Inventory Weapon Display to Thinner, only showing the Weapon Names, Bullet Image, Gun Tier, and Total DPS.
- Added Inventory Hover Functionality. When Hovering over a Weapon in the Inventory, a new Popup section for the Weapon comes up showing more details for the Weapon.
- Removed Draggable Functionality for Options Menu.

- Added new Keybind for Use Health. Bindable on Keyboard and X on XBOX Controller.

- Added Health Use Sound.
- Pressing B when using XBOX controller will now close menus.
- Shortened many of the weapon names to fit them in a smaller area.
- Added Mousewheel weapon select functionality. Scrolling the mousewheel will rotate through the equipped guns.
- Updated Tutorial text for new functionality.

The Inventory Overhaul was something I wanted to do for a little while as I wanted the inventory to be cleaner but also show more information for each weapon.

The Health Crate change was made in a way so that difficulty is removed a bit and health crates don't need to be left on screen for when you need HP, you can just pick them up and store it until you want to use one by using the Health Binding Key.
This feature came about by a great suggestion from TH1NK. 

I really appreciate the feedback and support from you guys and I will keep trying to improve the game.

[b]What's Next[/b]
- Vulnerable Enemy State (Enemy will take more damage in this state)
- Weakened Enemy State (Enemy will deal less damage in this state)
- Wet State ( A splash effect for when navigating on the water in the Courtyard)
- Mind Controlled State (Not sure how I will go about this one yet.)
- More Loot Costume Drops
- Overall adding more content whenever I think of something suitable.

The next main thing I want to add as well is the Level Select Overhaul which will have the level select taking up the middle of the screen, showing 1 Level at a time with a toggle left and right button. In front of the image display of the Level will be difficulty selection and challenge mode selection. EG. (Easy, Normal, Hard) Challenge Mode (Rails Only, Viperine Only, etc)

Once the level selection overhaul is done I will most likely be adding more Levels after that.

Thank you all
Luke Parisi

Luke Parisi
